entities.name: Eos
entities.description: One of the Inner Three nations of Bant, ruled by those with ancient documents claiming Topa's watering holes; home of the Olive Branch.

entities.name: Valeron
entities.description: Nation of which Eos is nominally the ally.

entities.name: Topa
entities.description: Nation disputing Eos's claim to ancient watering holes.

entities.name: Olive Branch
entities.description: Knightly order of Eos seeking to broker peace among Bant's nations.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Event after which Eos was attacked.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard where the attackers likely came from.

events.summary: After the Conflux, Eos is attacked by terrible forces, likely horrors from Grixis; Aran defends it valiantly but Eos Castle is left a smoking ruin.
events.quote: Eos was defended valiantly by Aran , but Eos Castle was left a smoking ruin.

relations.quote: Eos is home to the Olive Branch
